response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist software engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills, cloud exposure (AWS CDK), and recent, directly relevant work on MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure. However, the role requires 8+ years building production AI solutions, while the candidate's demonstrable GenAI experience only began in 2025. There is no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, data pipelines for unstructured data, or LLM evaluation/observability work, which are core to this Staff FDE role. Strong engineering fundamentals and teaching/consulting background make him worth a conversation, but the AI depth gap is significant.
strengths: Recent hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience, a key technology for this role
15+ years of production engineering across TypeScript, Node.js, cloud (AWS CDK), and high-scale systems
Proven mentorship and customer-facing skills via workshops, courses, conference talks, and consulting work
concerns: Falls far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of GenAI work)
No demonstrated experience with RAG, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, or LLM evaluation pipelines
Limited evidence of leading technical discovery with enterprise stakeholders at a staff/FDE level

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and mentoring track record
